About Field Notes

Nature, creativity
& shared curiosity.

Field Notes is an ecological design practice for people who want to pay closer attention—to their neighbourhoods, their shared places, and the stories held in small, ordinary encounters.

SELF-PORTRAIT, IN PROGRESS
TAKAPUNA · 2026

How this began

Looking is a practice.

Field Notes began with a habit: going out for a walk, bringing a notebook, and coming back with more questions than answers. It grew into a way of working across illustration, photography, guided walks, workshops and design.

The work is for lifelong experts and people who have only just started wondering what calls from the tree outside their window. No competition, no perfect knowledge—just the invitation to notice together.

Everything here is grounded in real encounters with places, species and people. It is a growing archive, not a finished statement.
